BH: B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He
content:
B"H # Core SSR Proof Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He. The Awtsmoos joins the hidden source to the visible word; on Awtsmoos.com the Road now carries its Torah in the first HTTP vessel, before JavaScript adds its living motion. ## Numeric Road proof Fresh isolated server: `127.0.0.1:8898`. Route: `/heichelos/ikar/series/BH-likkuteiTorah-שלח/4` Observed: - HTTP 200. - Title: `בפ' נסכים | Ikar | Awtsmoos` after entity decoding. - Stable canonical points to named post `BH_POST_1749784377821_theAlterRebbe_94`. - Robots: `index,follow,max-image-preview:large,max-snippet:-1,max-video-preview:-1`. - Real description present. - Real H1 present. - `data-awtsmoos-initial-post` article present. - Normalized article text length: 16,527 characters. - Calm/mobile CSS bundle present. - Calm reader client boot present. - Reader settings present. - No `ReferenceError`, `SyntaxError`, or dynamic-template error marker. - Assertion marker: `ROAD_RAW_HTML_PASS`. ## Stable named-post identity proof Named-post route returned HTTP 200 with the same title, H1, canonical URL, normalized body length, and exact SHA-256 body hash as the numeric Road. Body hash for both: `1f08e9709245f17eacb30baeb8732b7dde1505d8d7c4765e9825232bd0211f10` Assertion marker: `NAMED_POST_IDENTITY_PASS`. ## Missing-post safety proof A deliberately nonexistent named post returned: - robots: `noindex,follow`; - H1: `Torah teaching unavailable`; - missing-article semantic marker; - no template error. Assertion marker: `MISSING_POST_NOINDEX_PASS`. ## Parser defect discovered and resolved The template parser terminates embedded script at literal `?>`. The earlier `
` regex contained that byte sequence inside `/...\/?>/`, truncating the child template. The equivalent matcher now uses `/]*>/gi`, which preserves behavior without embedding the terminator.
